We also
note the launch of Wave 3 for MSFT Copilot which includes the offering of Anthropic's models
(beside OpenAI) and Claude Cowork capabilities and cements MSFT's role as a successful fast
follower of new technology. When MSFT launched Copilot a while ago, many investors asked why it was not part of a new
SKU (E7 for example). At the time, it seemed MSFT wanted to make Copilot available to a
broader audience (not just the high-end SKU customers) and hence the separate pricing. However, it does create friction in the sales process, especially for the enterprise level, if two
different pricing agreements (an Office SKU and the Copilot commitment) and discount levels
need to be discussed. In this respect, the new E7 offerings is just a natural extension. E7 includes
E5 plus Copilot and Agent 365. At $99 per user, the offering is above the $60 E5 price (price
update on July 2026) but is cheaper than the individual components (E5 $60 plus Copilot $30
plus Agent 365 $15). We note that in recent quarters, E5 was mentioned as the main growth
driver for Office growth, followed by Copilot. With its product announcements today, Microsoft also provides an answer for another recent
investor discussion point around the evolution of work.

Azure 供應受限時，Microsoft 點解仲有力推 E7 加價式 upsell？

text:
Azure 供應受限時，Microsoft 仍推動 E7 加價式 upsell，因 E7 SKU 的價值並非依賴 Azure 基礎服務，而是基於 M365 商業雲平台的整體生態，特別是其整合了 Microsoft 365 Copilot、Agent 365 及安全功能（如 Entra Suite）的端到端產品組合。E7 的推廣重點在於提升企業用戶的生產力、安全性與 AI 整合體驗，而非僅限於 Azure 的計算資源。

根據 Wells Fargo Securities 的分析，E7 SKU 以 $99/用戶/月的價格提供 E5 功能、Copilot、Agent 365 及 Entra Suite，總價較分項購買（E5 $60 + Copilot $30 + Agent 365 $15 = $105）低約 6%，提供顯著的價值優勢，並減少企業在銷售流程中需處理多個獨立合約的摩擦【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop | grep】。此舉不僅強化了產品的市場可及性，也透過「一體化」解決方案提升用戶採用意願。

此外，E7 的推廣與 Microsoft 365 商業雲的穩定增長密切相關。根據 Microsoft 2026 年 12 月的電話會議，M365 商業雲預計年收入增長介乎 13% 至 14%（以常數貨幣計算），顯示其業務基礎穩健，即使 Azure 供應受限，M365 作為核心業務仍能維持增長動能【KB:Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_2026128_RT00000】。

進一步而言，E7 的推出是對企業用戶需求的直接回應——企業用戶對 AI 工具（如 Copilot、Agent 365）的採用持續上升，內部已部署超過 50 萬個 Agent 365 代理，每日處理逾 6.5 萬次任務，顯示 AI 工具在內部流程中的實質價值【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_
